PROMOTED UNDER THE PRE-REGISTERED DIRECTION-BLIND RULE of the precommit §7 — owner signature B1 (card B, 2026-08-11: 're-adjudicate under a fresh precommit before any arm'). *** THE OBJECT IS A MIS-IDENTIFICATION (rules 1/23), NOT A PRICE RESIDUAL: ERCOT-140 identified the level on the 2024/25 SCED subsets and declared its 2023 application an extrapolation ('no 2023 SCED disclosure exists'); the ercot-157 delivery-2023 corpus dissolved that premise, and the constant's OWN instrument reads p90 = 75.00 $/MWh on the 2023 rows — level₂₀₂₃ 71.3378, i.e. +36.1389 = 14.42× the ±$2.5062 band, the armed constant being roughly HALF the measured 2023 top. The corpus's two most common submitted TOP steps in delivery-2023 are $78.00 (21,677 intervals) and $75.01 (17,869); $34.82 is a distant tenth. *** THE COVERAGE OBJECTION IS CLOSED BY BOUND, NOT BY REPAIR. ercot-169 could not license the read (curve_share 0.9702 vs the 0.9876 floor — the Martin Lake Mar–Jun no-curve block) and ercot-171 proved the licensed-sub-population route cannot reach a p90 of the curve TOP (G-NEUT +19.17 = 7.6× band), closing with 'an instrument that does not select on the tail would need its own charter'. This lane takes the route needing NO repair: the no-curve rows carry ZERO weight in a weighted quantile, so that weight is given the most extreme admissible price in each direction and the SAME statistic recomputed, bracketing the true quantile under ANY imputation whatsoever. The LOWER edge is 71.3378 in all three windows (matched-CST [71.3378, 81.3678], full-day [71.3378, 71.3578], raw-CPT [71.3378, 96.3378]) — so 2023's level is at least 14.42 band-widths above the armed constant no matter what the missing rows would have said. Card B's 'a 1.7 pp coverage shortfall cannot produce a 2× level shift' is now MEASURED, not asserted. Nothing dropped, nothing imputed, no licensing quantity swapped, the 0.9876 floor NOT lowered. Two alternative repairs were REFUSED in the pushed precommit BEFORE any level was read, on the Phase-0a structure measurement: own-conduct imputation (98.8 % of the missing headroom is ERCOT-123 bucket (b) price-taking at 98 % loading, so imputing a curve would invent an offer that was never submitted — rule 13) and re-expressing the licence on the exposure-matched a_offered (measured 0.94775 on 2023, i.e. WORSE than curve_share; a licensing quantity may never be chosen after seeing which one passes). *** NEUTRALITY, under AMENDMENT 1 (the measurement caught a defect in the precommit's own gate and it is recorded, not quietly fixed: ERCOT-140 anchors per subset and pools the anchored levels, ERCOT-137 pools the RAW bot_p50 un-anchored, so one arithmetic applied to both measured an anchoring inconsistency rather than the bound). Split into the halves its own words ask for: footing −0.0024 (limb A) / +2.6e-5 (limb C); LOWER-edge displacement — the edge carrying the 2023 verdict — 0.065× / 0.000× band. REPORTED not buried: the OPPOSITE edge displaces 2.635× band on those licensed subsets, because a p90 of a steep curve top admits a large upward excursion from even 0.3–0.7 % missing weight. *** LIMB A (coal_offer_net_revenue_margin) IS NOT-IDENTIFIABLE under this instrument (G-WINDOW: STRADDLES matched, REFUTED full-day) — the bound does NOT contradict ercot-171's CONFIRMED, it cannot sharpen it, and NO arm and NO change follow. *** ZERO FITTED SCALARS (rule 23): the value is the constant's own statistic on its own window with its own fuel response removed; no residual is consulted anywhere in the derivation. The SLOPE 10.4100 and the SHARED gas anchor 2.2494 are UNTOUCHED (rule 19) — one year cannot identify a slope. *** ALL PRE-REGISTERED KILL GATES PASS: G-BIT (2024+2025 BYTE-IDENTICAL A→B — all 12 hourly sidecar sha256s plus the per-year price/demand aggregates; the year table carries only 2023), G-COAL148 carried live (max rise 0.0 TWh vs the 0.5 bar; 2023 −0.0033) , G-SHED (4/1/0 → 4/1/0, no new shed year, slack MWh identical), G-DOF (zero fitted scalars, n_residual 6 UNCHANGED). G-OWNER does not escalate — C3a-2024 −0.8 % PASS, C3b-2024 0.135, C3a-2025 −7.5 %, all bit-identical to control by G-BIT. *** NOT C3a-2023 SPEND (card Q ruling Q-B, final at ercot-191): the residual moves are REPORTED AT FULL MAGNITUDE, were never targeted, are not a gate and are NOT the promotion basis — C3a-2023 −33.7 → −33.2 % ($42.63 → $42.97 vs actual $64.32), C3b-2023 0.610 → 0.604, C3c tails 58/181, 22/53, 1/31 UNCHANGED. NO C3a-2023 improvement is claimed. DETERMINATION NOT-YET, fail set {C3a-2023, C3b-2023} — UNCHANGED; C3c stays the single ledgered CAVEAT ×3 (ACCEPTED MODEL-CLASS LIMITATION). *** LOYO is structurally N/A: a single measured constant applied to ONE year, with 2024 and 2025 bit-identical by G-BIT — which IS the held-out evidence, since the change cannot buy in-sample gain anywhere but 2023. *** CARD B's STANDING DOF ITEM DISCHARGED: the three armed margin constants (ERCOT-137/139/140) now carry dedicated ledger entries on BOTH arms, with limb B's ercot-169 verification (boundary-coverage caveat carried), limb A's ercot-171 verification, and the newly measured ERCOT-137 anchoring inconsistency (+0.38 = 0.41× band, inside the band, arming unchanged, reported as an open convention issue). *** INHERITED NAMED PERMANENT LIMITATION (ercot-188/E2, unexpired): ercot_econ_curve_top_refine writes heat rates into the P0 objective, so the offer-surface family's P0 bit-identity proof remains FORFEITED on this keeper. market_story: COAL `_peak` (10 plants, ~5 % of the ERCOT coal fleet MW): in delivery-2023 the real coal fleet submitted the top of its SCED curve at $75–78/MWh, not the $34.82 it submitted in 2024/25 — flat at $75 in 9 of 12 months, fleet-wide rather than one plant. That is opportunity pricing of the last coal MW in a year whose scarcity and gas volatility made a coal plant's marginal MW worth far more as insurance than as energy; the same regime shift ercot-168 measured from the other end when Oak Grove repriced its overnight top to $60.26/$61.46 and two-shifted. Arming the year's own measured top means the model's coal fleet now declines to sell its last tranche below roughly what the fleet actually asked for, so that capacity stops setting the price cheaply in tight 2023 hours and the marginal unit there is the one the market actually cleared on. COAL energy is essentially unmoved (G-COAL148 rise 0.0 TWh, 2023 −0.0033), which is the point: this is a price-formation correction at the top of the curve, not a dispatch reallocation. 2024 and 2025 are BIT-IDENTICAL — those years keep the level measured on their own disclosure, because the correction is a per-year measurement, not a global re-tune.
